name: Sungold Capital Limited
about: Sungold Capital Limited operates as a non-banking finance company in India. It operates through the Financing Activity and Other segments. The company offers solutions for situations, including initial funding requirements of a project, mezzanine financing, project financing, bridge financing, short term, and long-term working capital requirements, as well as corporate loans; and Pixel Forge AI, a technology-driven AI platform focused on transforming digital content creation through intelligent automation. It is also involved in venture and financing in the entertainment business; asset financing; corporate and retail term loans; channel financing and bill discounting; provision of advisory services and wealth management; distribution of financial products; and leasing activities. Sungold Capital Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Rajpipla, India.
